review_candidates.title: Senior Helpdesk Officer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities: Classify client support cases by category, priority, and impact to ensure accurate routing and timely handling. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex application incidents and service requests within the assigned support scope, applying appropriate diagnostic techniques and available knowledge resources to restore service within agreed service levels. Supervise the day-to-day activities of Helpdesk Agents, including workload coordination, case allocation, service-q
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Supervise the day-to-day activities of Helpdesk Agents, including workload coordination, case allocation, service-quality monitoring, and performance feedback, while providing technical guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing on complex cases and support procedures, and ensuring adherence to established support procedures and service-level requirements. Verify client support entitlement and applicable service levels using approved contractual and service information, escalating exceptions or unclear contractual requirements to the Service Manager. Requirements : Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, MIS, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in application support and incident management. Strong hands-on experience in managing application issues throughout the incident/service lifecycle.
